mechanism: Aggressive option trade flow may contain informed directional demand. Buy calls and sell puts are treated as bullish pressure; sell calls and buy puts as bearish pressure. Large premium-weighted imbalance during active trading windows is hypothesized to predict same-direction BTC index movement over the next 24h.

chronology.rule: Do not open 2019/2020 future-return outcomes unless Discovery passes its frozen gate.

aggregation.price_proxy: last index_price observed in the 4h bin
aggregation.price_freshness: last option trade carrying index_price must be within 30 minutes of the 4h bin end for both entry and exit

signal.imbalance_extreme: abs(imbalance) >= trailing past-only 90th percentile of abs(imbalance)
signal.direction: sign(imbalance), i.e. continuation of signed option flow
signal.overlap: one active 24h position at a time; overlapping signals ignored

pnl.note: Index price is a research proxy, not an executable venue fill.

no_rescue: Do not change 4h aggregation after outcomes.
Do not change 90th percentile imbalance threshold after outcomes.
Do not change median activity filter after outcomes.
Do not change 24h horizon after outcomes.
Do not invert continuation to contrarian after outcomes.
Do not add IV/DTE/strike filters after outcomes.
Do not open 2019 or 2020 to rescue a Discovery failure.
